Title: Aditya's Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Sonali - 40 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Isha - 13 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
4. Vimla - 71 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
3. The classroom - a blackboard, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Sonali, Isha and Vimla stand near him.]

Isha: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditya slips and falls.]

Vimla (softly): "Well done!"

[Aditya trips over a stone.]

Aditya: "That's great!"

[Aditya hurts his knee.]

Aditya (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Aditya helps Mother get up.]

Aditya (excited): "Mom, look at this."

[Aditya sneezes loudly.]

Isha: "Oh wow!"

[Aditya coughs.]

Sonali: "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

Vimla: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya yawns loudly.]

Vimla: "That was fun!"

[Aditya stretches his arms above his head.]

Aditya (surprised): "That's easy."

[Aditya goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Aditya: "Oh wow!"

[Aditya sits on the edge of the bed.]

Sonali: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The classroom - Day

[Aditya stands in the classroom. Sonali and Isha stand near him.]

Sonali: "What a nice place."

[Aditya raises his hand to answer.]

Isha: "I knew it!"

[Aditya writes on the blackboard.]

Aditya (excited): "Exactly right."

[Aditya reads his book at his desk.]

Sonali: "Isha, look at this."

[Aditya yawns in the class.]

Sonali: "What a day to remember!"
